Mr. Mukul Dangi, learned counsel for the 
applicants.
Mr. V.K. Gemini, learned Deputy Advocate 
General for the State.
Mr. H.S. Rawal, learned counsel for the 
private respondent.
In pursuance to the order passed by this 
Court in today’s proceeding, this Court has 
passed an earlier order referring the parties to the 
mediator.
In pursuance to the earlier report of 
24.07.2023, the mediator was called upon to 
furnish his report and the same has been 
submitted.

mediation proceedings have failed. As a result, 
thereto, there is no other option left, except to 
hear the C482 Application on its own merits.

October, 2023.

08.06.2023 would remain extended till the next 
date of listing.
